text: CJP GETS A FREE RIDE. PM'S MESSAGE DOESN'T? META-STIZED CENSORSHIP? BUT AT WHOSE INSTIGATION? Many on social media are sharing this screenshot of Facebook allegedly restricting PM Modi's critical selfie video assuring protesters. If true, it raises serious questions about interference in India's internal affairs. But perhaps it was only a matter of time. Meta's platforms, Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, earn enormously from content created by Indian media, businesses and hundreds of millions of users through advertising revenue from the Indian market. They exercise enormous power over what people see, what gets amplified, what gets buried and, most importantly, over the advertising revenue that flows from this vast ecosystem. That concentration of power is deeply disturbing. It also raises the concern that India may have entered a phase where its democratic discourse is vulnerable to manipulation, censorship by entities that operate beyond the country's democratic accountability. That is precisely why it is unwise to take any self-proclaimed "prophet of change", including CJP, at face value. There is already speculation and evidence that increasingly protests in "public interest" are SPONSORED and that some "PROTESTORS" are, in effect, "HUMAN BOT ARMIES" serving deeply entrenched anti-India vested interests. text: कायदे से उन ऐंकरों को जाना चाहिए था, जिनसे चैनल की पहचान है। अच्छा है इसी बहाने नए चेहरों को मौक़ा मिल जाता है। ऐसा लगता है कि संवाददाता से अनजाने में यह बात निकल गई होगी, क्योंकि 2014 के बाद से यही पैटर्न बना दिया गया है। धरना प्रदर्शन को सीधे देश विरोधी साज़िश से जोड़ दिया जाता है और नारों से डराया जाने लगता है। इसी का इतना भय हो गया है कि धरना प्रदर्शन के पहले ही लोग कहने लगते हैं कि विपक्ष से हम दूर हैं। यह समस्या कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी की नहीं, महिला कुश्ती खिलाड़ियों की भी थी, शायद उससे पहले किसान आंदोलन की। इस बार एक चेंज दिख रहा है। विपक्ष और धरना प्रदर्शन को लेकर झिझक टूटने लगी है। कई दल गए हैं। कांग्रेस ने भी नैतिक समर्थन दे दिया है। गोदी मीडिया यहाँ से क्या करेगा? कांग्रेस के समर्थन के बाद इस अनशन को मोदी के ख़िलाफ बड़ी साज़िश बताने लग जाएगा या मोदी सरकार से सवाल करेगा। अभिजीत ने पहले जो भी कहा हो मगर राहुल गांधी के सवाल को कैसे हैंडल करना है, यह बात अब समझने लगे हैं। इसीलिए नए लोगों से ख़ूब सवाल होने चाहिए। कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी से यह सवाल नहीं होता तो यह बदलाव नहीं आता। जनता की निगाह में आना, उसके भरोसे पर उतरना आसान काम नहीं है।

If the government is concerned about security at the protest site, we are willing to meet at a neutral venue near Jantar Mantar. We are still waiting to hear back from them. He adds, “The government must have the intention to accept our demands. There is no point in calling us for meaningless discussions. Our time is valuable. author: khalidbaig85
text: The lukewarm response that the Cockroach Janta Party founders are witnessing at Jantar Mantar are the signs of the times we live in. Maasive following on Insta and Fb does not translate into on ground support. The generation which follows you on social media, especially the one's born post 2000, will not be willing to hit the streets. Heck, they are not even willing to walk down the road to get their daily household needs, because Blinkit, Zomato, Swiggy and their fourth friend Amazon, are all there, at their service. If only Urban Company and Pronto had an option, where one could hire protestors on one's behalf to protest for a cause, then the dwindling prospects of Cockroach Janta Party would have got a massive boost, but as of now, that functionality is not provided, but you never know. Second, the faces of this movement lack charisma and public connect. Abhijeet Dipke is no mass leader, like Arvind Kejriwal, his persona and his background does not make the person behind the screen go like 'Woah, he is the guy I am willing to take 1 day off from my office'. Saurav Das and the other fellow, who keeps dancing to songs of 1990's Bollywood are not even Twitter celebrities. Also why would the generation following them, born post 2000, vibe to songs of Bollywood movies of 90's and the era of 2000 to 2010. I did enjoy their dance performance, but then I am not your target audience. Similarly for all of Sonam Wangchuk's achievements, he too is no Anna Hazare and India of 2026, is not India of 2012. Life in India has become more comfortable, while the income disparity remains, both these truths run parallel. The issue of NEET, Ethanol are the one's which the ruling government should be rightly questioned about and one can even see supporters of the current government taking them to task on these 2 major issues. However, the fast unto death emotional blackmail type of protest is passe. It no longer appeals to the current generation, neither to the one's previous to them, who actually grew up watching such protests overturn governments of the day. A few days back, came across a clip of my friend @Iyervval where he spoke about how we don't realize that how far India has come from the days of abject poverty and this is where the answer to the lack of response to CJP's Dharna Party lies. More than anything else, it is the lack of imagination on behalf of CJP, and taking a traditional route, which finds itself a lost child in today's comfort at the drop of an app button playstore. Meanwhile, it is activist and News influencer @tehseenp 's campaign highlighting the issue of Ethanol that is drawing more attention, where in the elected representatives of the day,are being grudingly forced to acknowledge the issue. May be, just may be, CJP folks study what AIM and Tehseen are saying and take a leaf out of their book. 2026 is not 2012!

author: grok
text: **Fact check:** Mostly interpretive opinion with some facts. Sonam Wangchuk joined the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP, satirical youth group founded by Abhijeet Dipke) protest at Jantar Mantar ~June 28 and began an indefinite hunger strike. Demands: Dharmendra Pradhan’s resignation over alleged NEET-UG 2026 irregularities (re-exam was held) + Ladakh issues. His prior Ladakh environmental fasts had wider support. Joining a direct anti-govt protest has polarized opinions — common when activism turns explicitly political. “Pradhan responsible” is an allegation/demand, not proven fact. Protests focus on accountability so far; medical checks ongoing (per image). No major reported police clash or deliberate “sidelining” of NEET. CJP mixes satire, youth anger, and serious demands. Perceptions shift when figures like Wangchuk broaden causes. Serious exam issues exist and need transparent probes.
